answer: One defence is Cleared oil rig safety officer certificate with offshore safety attestation: a certificate safety officers renew after drill audits, and the oasis of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the ledge is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the lotus of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
